description:
Correct the location of 'noisy' GPS points by snapping them to the nearest road segments. 

1. Open QGIS.
2. Load the reference road layer '/home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_lines.geojson' and the GPS data '/home/ga/GIS_Data/noisy_gps_points.geojson'.
3. Use the 'Snap geometries to layer' algorithm from the Processing Toolbox.
4. Configure it to snap 'noisy_gps_points' to the 'sample_lines' reference layer.
5. Set the tolerance to 0.05 degrees and behavior to 'Prefer closest point'.
6. Run the tool and export the result as GeoJSON to '/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/snapped_points.geojson'.
